goal: Add the two given todos, mark 'buy milk' as completed, then open the Active filter, so that only 'walk the dog' is listed and the footer says '1 item left'.
notes: Type a todo into the 'What needs to be done?' field and press Enter to add it. Each todo has a round checkbox on its left that marks it completed. The filters All / Active / Completed are links in the footer.

checks.two_todos: The list shows both 'buy milk' and 'walk the dog'
checks.milk_done: The todo 'buy milk' is shown as completed (checked and struck through)

active_filtered.when: The Active filter is selected and the list shows only 'walk the dog'. The footer says '1 item left'

app_error.when: An error message or a blank page is shown instead of the todo list
